## Données

- NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission, *TLC Trip Record Data* (taxis jaunes et verts,
  2019-2020, 2024-2025) et *Taxi Zone Lookup Table* :
  [nyc.gov](https://www.nyc.gov/site/tlc/about/tlc-trip-record-data.page)
- Open-Meteo, *Historical Weather API* (réanalyse ERA5) :
  [open-meteo.com](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api)
- Jours fériés US : paquet Python [`holidays`](https://pypi.org/project/holidays/)
